svg.data-weight-note: 16.73 lb (7.59 kg) with the fan modules and the default power supplies installed (Table 43); the community NetBox file gives 7.59 kg too
svg.data-poe-budget-note: 437 W with the default PWR-C1-715WAC-P (Table 18); the guide lists 445 W for the C9300-24P
svg.data-power-supply-options: PWR-C1-350WAC, PWR-C1-350WAC-P, PWR-C1-715WAC, PWR-C1-715WAC-P, PWR-C1-1100WAC, PWR-C1-1100WAC-P, PWR-C1-1900WAC-P, PWR-C1-1900WHV-T, PWR-C1-715WDC (Tables 18 and 35)
svg.data-altitude: operating up to 3000 m (10,000 ft); storage up to 4500 m (15,000 ft)
svg.data-stacking: StackWise-480 data stacking, up to nine switches, and StackPower, up to four switches
svg.data-uplink-modules: one network module slot; C9300-NM-2Q, -4G, -4M, -2Y, -8X and the 3850 uplink modules (Table 5); a blank when none is fitted
svg.data-console: USB mini-Type B on the front and RJ-45 on the rear; the USB console takes precedence
svg.data-oob: RJ-45 10/100/1000 management port on the rear
svg.data-usb: USB Type A storage port on the front; USB 3.0 SSD slot on the rear
